choices.returns: P_t / P_(t-1) - 1 over consecutive file rows (sorted by date) on which both closes exist; spread days are rows with both r_MTUM and r_SPY defined
choices.month_end: the last spread day of the calendar month; v_m over the 126 spread days ending at and including it; a zero realised variance gives w = 1
choices.first_month_end: the first month-end with 126 spread days available (m0); the first strategy month is the calendar month after m0
choices.last_month: the last complete month of bench.csv: complete if the file has a date in a later month or its last date is the final weekday (Mon-Fri) of the month
choices.execution: on the first spread day of each strategy month the day's return is earned at the drifted old holdings, then holdings reset to (w, 1 - w) and 0.002 x |w - w_prev| is deducted from that day's return; the sleeve starts all in SPY with w_prev = 0
choices.monthly_returns: all four series compound daily returns over the strategy month's spread days; no other SPY trading days are used
choices.mtum_held: pure MTUM daily returns from the first spread day of the first strategy month, no cost, no delay; so S_m is the raw ETF difference, as the regressor in (a) should be
choices.fifty_fifty: the same daily engine with w = 0.5 every month and the same cost rule on decided weights: 0.002 x |0.5 - 0| at establishment and 0.002 x |0.5 - 0.5| = 0 thereafter, i.e. the drift re-balance is not charged because the rule charges |w_m - w_(m-1)|, not the drifted fraction
choices.costs: no drift cost for the strategy either: the charge is on the decided-weight change only, as the PREREG defines the traded fraction; the cost is deducted additively from the execution day's return, 1 + r_day = 1 + x.r - 0.002 x |w - w_prev|, not multiplicatively
choices.rf: RF per month = prod(1 + RF / 100) - 1 over all ff5_daily.csv rows in the calendar month; a month the French file has not completed (same completeness rule) is treated as missing; (c) and the four Sharpes then use only the months with RF, and rf_months_missing lists the rest
choices.sharpe_b_threshold: Sharpe(S) > 0: Sharpe(A) >= 1.2 x Sharpe(S); otherwise Sharpe(A) >= Sharpe(S) + 0.2 x |Sharpe(S)|
choices.bootstrap: tools/volmom/PREREG.md 3(b) verbatim; a nan Sharpe difference in a resample is counted on the <= 0 side
choices.newey_west: sandwich with Bartlett weights 1 - l / (L + 1), L = 3, no n / (n - k) factor
choices.verdict: INSUFFICIENT below 96 months; UNSCORABLE if (c) has no RF month at all; else PASS / WEAK / FAIL per the PREREG
choices.stats: ann_return geometric ((prod(1 + r))^(12 / n) - 1); ann_vol sqrt(12) x sd (ddof 1); sharpe over RF; max_drawdown from monthly wealth starting at 1, reported as a negative fraction
choices.weight_series: the n executed weights (decided at the month-ends from m0 to the month before the last complete month); share_capped is w >= 1; share_below_half is w < 0.5
choices.turnover: sum of |w_m - w_(m-1)| over the executed rebalances, the first term being |w_m0 - 0|, annualised by 12 / n; cost_annual = 0.002 x turnover_annual
choices.yearly: calendar-year compounding of the strategy months in that year; partial first and last years included as they stand, with the month count
choices.live_weight: last_complete_month: the weight decided at the last spread day of the last complete month; latest: the weight over the 126 spread days ending at the last spread day in the file
